name: B10-0135/2024 (Renew) – People’s Republic of China’s misinterpretation of the UN resolution 2758 and its continuous military provocations around Taiwan
title: People’s Republic of China’s misinterpretation of the UN resolution 2758 and its continuous military provocations around Taiwan
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union and its member states to back Taiwan's participation in international bodies such as the World Health Organization, the UN climate convention, Interpol and the International Civil Aviation Organization. It says a 1971 UN resolution about China does not decide Taiwan's future. It condemns China's military drills around Taiwan in October 2024 and asks China to stop them. It restates support for the EU's One China policy. The text is a statement of position, not a law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the EU and member states to act; it cannot decide this alone.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, China, Taiwan, and international bodies like the World Health Organization.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to EU institutions, UN member states and Taiwan's government.
